description: RFC 8785 number serialization (ECMAScript Number::toString). `input.ieee754` is the big-endian hex of an IEEE 754 double. `errors` (NaN, infinities) must be rejected.
source: RFC 8785 Appendix B, plus a seeded sample serialized by the JavaScript engine (Node.js 22). Regenerate with generate-numbers.mjs.

vectors.name: rfc8785 appendix B ffefffffffffffff (max negative number)
rfc8785 appendix B c340000000000000 (max negative integer)
